paragraphs.text: The Red Agates is a group of islands somewhere in the Sea of Serenity in southwestern Jamuraa , on the plane of Dominaria .

In 3334 AR , after the Battle of Bryce , Hazezon Tamar sent words of warning and a plea for aid in the form of soldiers from several of the city-states on the Craggy Coast . Along with the coastal cities of Shaibara , Yerkoy , Enez , and Kalan , the ship would stop at the Red Agates, indicating the archipelago was not far out to sea from the coast.
